decision.paused_scope: the 9,000-coordinate, 16-arm primary causal factorial and its downstream 7,200-coordinate seed extension
decision.effect_on_prior_contract: The prior factorial remains frozen and reportable as unexecuted. This manifest neither edits its arms and gates nor permits a partial matrix to be labeled complete. Resumption requires a later explicit amendment and every original prerequisite.
decision.effect_on_core: none; the terminal 4,500-shard P2 core matrix and both terminal summaries remain immutable and separately reportable
decision.effect_on_downstream_gates: The targeted study cannot satisfy the original primary or confirmatory causal-factorial gate; every P3 path that requires those terminal audits remains blocked.

exogenous_july_17_pivot.timing: frozen while P2 core was still running and before either terminal core summary existed
exogenous_july_17_pivot.decision_relevance: demoted the broad adaptive-memory/runtime build and prioritized a trace-first native cross-path sufficiency study

observed_before_this_freeze: the terminal core quality audit and its strict copy
the completed S55/6071401 causal path-equivalence audit
the failed S55/6071402 causal path-equivalence audit and its seven already-known mismatched arm records
not_observed_before_this_freeze: any result from the four-corner path-by-residency diagnostic defined here
any result from the prospective equivalence panel defined here
any 807-series held-out result for the staged exploratory decision panel
any held-out causal-factorial shard or causal-factorial quality summary
timing_and_observation_boundary.selection_disclosure: The path-localization cells are selected because their mismatches were already observed. They are localization-only and are prohibited from confirmatory inference, effect estimation, equivalence-rate claims, or quality claims. The exploratory targeted panel retains every pre-existing scale, budget, family, and context but freezes replicate 0 only; neither its coordinates nor gates are selected from its unseen outcomes.

reasons.detail: The July-17 frontier decision predates terminal core outcomes and makes a full legacy controller factorial lower priority than trace-first cross-path research.
The original primary contract requires 9,000 coordinates, 2,880,000 quality arm-conversations, and 720,000 direct physical arm-conversations before the separate 7,200-coordinate extension.

Only two of ten checkpoint-scale equivalence audits exist at freeze time; S55/6071402 fails exact prediction equivalence in 7 of 5,760 records, and eight checkpoint-scale audits are absent. No held-out causal-factorial shard may run through that failed prerequisite.

pause_basis.interpretation: This is a documented portfolio pause plus a fail-closed computational-equivalence blocker, not outcome-dependent deletion of a low-quality arm or scale.

path_split_diagnostic.purpose: Localize whether the known prediction divergence is caused by chunking, residency implementation, or their interaction before any causal quality contrast is interpreted.
paired_controls: identical dtype and recorded kernel settings within one process
identical configured layer quotas, pin set, and fallback setting
deterministic globally near-balanced corner order with each positional count differing by at most one

localization_panel.source: the digest-bound S55/6071402 raw equivalence artifact above
localization_panel.required_arm_cells: the seven already-known mismatched arm-cell records listed above
localization_panel.optional_non_gating_controls: already-passing arms from the same two cells may be run for localization context but cannot enter any gate or inference
required_trace: selected-block identity digest at every controller action
first divergent layer and token when present
prohibited_uses: selection or tuning of a quality threshold

prospective_equivalence_panel.role: outcome-independent staged path audit; computational equivalence only
prospective_equivalence_panel.generation_seed_formula: generation_seed_base_by_scale[scale] + (training_seed-6071401)*100000000 + family_index*10000000 + context*1000; family_index follows the frozen p2-causal-factorial-v1 family order
prospective_equivalence_panel.required_corners: all four execution-path by residency corners once, followed by one additional sequential-tiered integrity replay of the same input and configuration
prospective_equivalence_panel.collision_rule: fail if any generated conversation content digest equals a localization-panel conversation
prospective_equivalence_panel.outcome_access: targets may be carried for deterministic replay but accuracy is not computed or inspected until the equivalence audit is terminal

cross_corner_interchangeability_gate.pass: Exact token predictions, selected-block identities, controller counters, quota totals, pin sets, fallback actions, and budget checks across all four corners permit only a computational interchangeability statement for this prospective panel.
cross_corner_interchangeability_gate.fail: Any cross-corner mismatch kills or narrows execution-corner interchangeability claims and must be localized without deleting the record. It does not block the physical-only targeted study, whose frozen execution corner is sequential-tiered.
cross_corner_interchangeability_gate.repair_rule: A code or numerical repair requires a new implementation digest and newly frozen fresh path-panel seed namespace before any later cross-corner equivalence claim.
cross_corner_interchangeability_gate.localization_does_not_unlock: Reproducing or fixing only the seven known arm-cell records never establishes population path equivalence.

sequential_tiered_eligibility_gate.scope: stage-specific eligibility for the targeted study only
sequential_tiered_eligibility_gate.pass: For the arms admitted to the current stage, sequential-tiered repeats are internally deterministic in every required localization arm-cell, and every prospective sequential-tiered record has stable action, budget, pin-set, fallback, and artifact digests with no unexplained same-path drift.
sequential_tiered_eligibility_gate.fail: Any unexplained sequential-tiered repeat drift, action drift, budget violation, pin-set drift, fallback drift, or integrity/provenance failure blocks the affected stage.

nonclaims: no evidence for adaptive quota, pins, hierarchy, or HCA
no proof of population-wide equivalence from the known cells
no production latency, throughput, HBM, or transfer claim

targeted_causal_study.purpose: First screen calibrated layer identity with the exact-multiset pair. Only if that mechanism screen passes, pay the fixed-policy calibration and execution cost needed to screen deployed operational benefit.
targeted_causal_study.relationship_to_original_factorial: This preserves the original arm definitions and every factor level but freezes only replicate 0 and three arms. It is exploratory, cannot replace the 16-arm factorial, and cannot support confirmatory or component claims.

stage_sequence.name: clean_layer_identity
prerequisites: exact quota-multiset, total, pin-set, fallback, and configuration controls
stage_sequence.stop_rule: If the frozen preliminary clean-layer-identity continue gate fails, report Stage A, disclose the two already-existing S55/6071401 and S55/6071402 fixed-match artifacts, and do not build any additional fixed memory-match prerequisites or run Stage B.

stage_sequence.name: deployed_operational
prerequisites: calibration-only physical hot-memory matching for fixed+pins
stage_sequence.stop_rule: If calibration-only matching or integrity fails, report Stage B as blocked; do not retune on 807-series data.

clean_layer_identity.estimand: effect of assigning the same non-uniform quota multiset to its calibrated layer identities rather than a calibration-digest-derived cyclic shuffle
required_exact_controls_per_batch: identical protected pin policy and pin-set digest
identical fallback and causal signal settings
identical conversation, checkpoint, dtype, and execution corner
clean_layer_identity.uniform_mapping_rule: If the calibrated and shuffled mappings are structurally identical, retain the record for audit but exclude it from layer-identity evidence and report its zero-identification status.
clean_layer_identity.claim_scope: clean causal layer-identity contrast on Tier-S synthetic workloads

deployed_operational.estimand: operational effect of the deployed calibrated allocation relative to the calibration-frozen low/high fixed schedule at matched mean physical hot memory
deployed_operational.memory_requirement: mean measured hot-resident bytes within 1 percent in every seed-scale-budget cell using 707-series calibration only, then reported again on held-out data
deployed_operational.confounding_disclosure: The fixed low/high schedule can change total configured quota per batch. Therefore this contrast combines layer allocation with per-batch total/schedule variation and is not a pure allocation effect.

deployed_exact_total_stratum.contrast: calibrated+pins - fixed+pins restricted to configuration-eligible exact-total batches
deployed_exact_total_stratum.eligibility: The exact configured-total equality indicator must be computed from frozen arm configurations and the 707-series schedule before any 807-series target or prediction is read.
required_exact_controls_per_batch: identical protected pin policy and pin-set digest
identical conversation, checkpoint, dtype, and execution corner
deployed_exact_total_stratum.feasibility_rule: Report this stratum only if every scale-budget cell contains all five seeds and at least 200 eligible conversations per seed. Otherwise report it as unavailable; do not change the fixed schedule, interpolate accuracy, or filter on outcomes.
deployed_exact_total_stratum.interpretation: supporting exact-total allocation contrast only; the clean shuffled-quota contrast remains the primary layer-identity test

frozen_grid.workload_seed_formula: evaluation_seed + family_index*10000000 + context*1000 + replicate; family_index follows the frozen p2-causal-factorial-v1 family order and replicate is exactly 0

statistics.conversation_outcome: query accuracy = correct_count / total registered query positions within the conversation
statistics.paired_difference: candidate conversation query accuracy minus comparator conversation query accuracy on the identical targets and query positions
statistics.cell_seed_effect: unweighted arithmetic mean of eligible paired conversation differences across all nine families, five contexts, and twenty conversations in one training-seed x scale x budget cell
statistics.pooled_cell_effect: unweighted arithmetic mean of the five frozen training-seed effects; all five seeds must be present
statistics.bootstrap_algorithm: NumPy default_rng draws a 10000 by 5 integer index matrix uniformly with replacement from the ordered five seed effects; each row mean forms the bootstrap distribution; report the linear-interpolated percentile quantiles at 0.025 and 0.975
statistics.bootstrap_seed_cell_offset: add 0, 1, 2, or 3 in lexicographic (scale, budget) order: s151/2x, s151/4x, s55/2x, s55/4x
statistics.multiplicity: No confirmatory multiplicity claim is made. Report every contrast-by-scale-by-budget estimate and its descriptive 95 percent seed-cluster interval.
statistics.exact_seed_sign_flip: enumerate all 32 assignments; report the resolution-limited p-value but do not use p<0.05 as a gate
statistics.exact_seed_sign_flip_rule: two-sided fraction of the 32 signed five-seed means whose absolute value is at least abs(observed mean)-16*float64 epsilon
statistics.missing_or_invalid_pair_rule: no imputation; any missing required arm pair, target mismatch, query-position mismatch, exact-control violation, non-finite value, or absent seed blocks the affected stage
statistics.uniform_mapping_exclusion_rule: retain and count structurally identical calibrated/shuffled mappings in the audit, exclude them from the Stage-A effect before reading targets, and require all five seeds plus at least 200 identified conversations per seed in every scale-budget cell

preliminary_decision_gates.stage_a_eligibility: Sequential-tiered integrity passes for calibrated+pins and shuffled-quota+pins, and every clean exact-control check passes. No fixed arm or physical fixed-match artifact is required. Cross-corner equivalence is not required.
preliminary_decision_gates.clean_layer_identity_continue: Preliminary GO only if, in each of four scale-by-budget cells, the pooled effect is strictly positive, at least four of five seed effects are strictly positive, and the descriptive 95 percent seed-cluster interval has a nonnegative lower bound.
preliminary_decision_gates.stage_b_eligibility: Stage A reaches preliminary GO, sequential-tiered integrity passes for fixed+pins, and the fixed arm passes calibration-only physical hot-memory matching before any Stage-B 807-series result is read.
preliminary_decision_gates.deployed_operational_continue: Preliminary GO only if, in each of four scale-by-budget cells, the pooled effect is strictly positive, at least four of five seed effects are strictly positive, the descriptive 95 percent seed-cluster interval has a nonnegative lower bound, and the one-percent memory-match contract holds.
preliminary_decision_gates.mechanism_no_go: Failure of any clean-layer-identity decision cell stops further adaptive-quota mechanism investment under this line and prevents Stage B, including its fixed memory-match prerequisites. It is a preliminary program decision, not confirmatory evidence that the population effect is null or negative.
preliminary_decision_gates.deployment_no_go: Failure of any deployed-operational decision cell stops adaptive-quota systems expansion, even if the clean screen passes. It is not a confirmatory deployed-superiority test.
preliminary_decision_gates.full_factorial_resume: Passing both gates does not automatically resume the 16-arm factorial; it only permits a separate resource and novelty review followed by an explicit amendment.

nonclaims: not an estimate of the protected-pin effect
not an estimate of local adaptation, hierarchy, cross-layer signaling, refresh reuse, score concentration, or fallback effects
not a completed or reduced substitute for the 16-arm causal factorial
not confirmatory inference or a paper-grade causal effect estimate
not natural-language, model-family, long-context, or production generalization
not a latency, throughput, HBM-capacity, transfer, or cost benefit
not evidence for the July-17 HCA conditional-information hypotheses
not native-quality preservation unless a separate native contrast is executed under a frozen contract
not a pure allocation claim from calibrated+pins versus fixed+pins unless the prospectively eligible exact-total stratum is available

reporting_rules: Report the original core, the full-factorial pause, the path-localization panel, the prospective equivalence audit, and the targeted contrasts as separate evidence objects.
Never pool the known mismatch cells with the prospective equivalence panel or use them in a confidence interval or p-value.
Never drop a failing corner, arm, seed, scale, budget, family, context, or exact-control violation.
Report unavailable exact-total strata and blocked studies explicitly rather than repairing them after target observation.
Retain raw per-batch quota totals, sorted quota-multiset digests, pin-set digests, measured hot bytes, execution-corner labels, and artifact SHA-256 values.
claim_boundary: This post-core amendment pauses the legacy full factorial and preregisters only a computational path-by-residency diagnostic plus a 900-coordinate exploratory three-arm Tier-S decision panel. Known failure cells can localize implementation divergence but are never confirmatory. Cross-corner mismatch limits interchangeability claims but does not block the sequential-tiered panel. The clean calibrated-versus-shuffled screen is interpretable only when quota multisets and pins are exact; the calibrated-versus-fixed screen is operational and remains confounded by per-batch total scheduling unless a prospectively defined exact-total stratum exists. Neither screen supports confirmatory inference.
